headline: 2Q beat on the back of ex-corporate demand

highlights: Key Points  LEMONTRE’s 2QFY27 EBITDA came ~10% ahead of our estimate on account of strong ~18% RevPAR growth spread across the brands and regions.

The management alluded to the fact that RevPAR growth is purely not a function of renovation led ARR growth, as overall occupancy also improved materially across the brands.  While 2Q exceeded expectations and fears about West Asia crisis waning, the management sounded cautiously optimistic about the H2FY27 outlook considering the inflationary scenario and its potential impact on particularly midscale category.

LEMONTRE follows largely capital light growth approach; however, supply outpacing demand in the relevant category could restrict its ability to raise pricing, in our view.  Overall, we are building in Revenue/EBITDA CAGR of 13%/16% over FY26–FY29E and continue to value LEMONTRE at 11x EV/EBITDA.

The discount in target multiple vs peers is on account of relatively higher earnings sensitivity to ARR changes and leverage. 2QFY27 performance update: LEMONTREs consolidated revenue growth of ~18% was a function of ~18% RevPAR growth wherein ARR grew by 8% YoY and occupancy witnessed an improvement of 630bps YoY.
valuation: LEMONTRE follows largely capital light growth approach; however, supply outpacing demand in the relevant category could restrict its ability to raise pricing, in our view.  Overall, we are building in Revenue/EBITDA CAGR of 13%/16% over FY26–FY29E and continue to value LEMONTRE at 11x EV/EBITDA.
After factoring in ~27% YTD correction in the stock price and rolling forward valuation to Sep’28E, we upgrade it to BUY with a revised TP of Rs140 (earlier Rs126).
